about: Cemindia Projects Limited provides construction and civil engineering contracting services in India. The company constructs maritime structures, including jetties, dolphins, service platforms, quay, berths on concrete and steel piles, solid gravity type wharf structures, ship lifts, dry docks, wet basins, and inclined berths; mass rapid transport systems (MRTs); airports; highways, bridges, and flyovers; foundations and specialized engineering works comprising geotechnical investigations, piling
